tools.description: Run deep, multi-step web research on a query and return a synthesized answer with sources. Runs as an async job. Long-running: returns a job immediately; poll it with check_job(job_id) every few seconds until status is 'success' or 'fail'.

model.description: Which provider/model to run, exactly one of: firecrawl, linkup, tavily. Call list_models for pricing.

prompt.description: Natural-language research task for the agent

reasoning_depth.description: Research reasoning-effort tier (billed per tier; priced pre-call)

schema.description: JSON schema describing the structured output

tools.name: web_scraping
tools.description: Fetch a single URL and return its clean content as markdown, text, or HTML, with optional JavaScript rendering.

model.description: Which provider/model to run, exactly one of: firecrawl, linkup, tavily. Call list_models for pricing.

url.description: URL of the web page to scrape

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for a query and return ranked results (title, URL, and a snippet or the page content).

model.description: Which provider/model to run, exactly one of: firecrawl, linkup, tavily. Call list_models for pricing.

max_results.description: Max number of search results to return

depth.description: Search depth tier (billed per tier; priced pre-call)

tools.name: web_structured_extraction
tools.description: Extract structured data from one or more web pages against a schema or prompt. Runs as an async job. Long-running: returns a job immediately; poll it with check_job(job_id) every few seconds until status is 'success' or 'fail'.

model.description: Which provider/model to run, exactly one of: firecrawl. Call list_models for pricing.

urls.description: URLs to extract structured data from (async job)

prompt.description: Natural-language description of what to extract

schema.description: JSON schema describing the structured output
